scenario: Enemy soldiers have taken over my village and will kill all civilians above the age of two. I and ten neighbors are hiding in two rooms of the cellar of a large house. I can hear the voices of soldiers who have come to search the house for valuables. My baby begins to cry loudly. The crying will attract the attention of the soldiers, who will spare my baby’s life, but will kill me and the other refugees in both rooms. If I put my hand over its mouth the crying will be absorbed, but my baby will not be able to breathe. This will kill it, but it will save me and the other ten neighbors.
choice: I decide to absorb the crying by putting your hand over your baby’s mouth
entities: i,my baby,an unknown number of enemy soldiers searching the house,an unknown number of other enemy soldiers occupying the village,an unknown number of other civilians above age 2 in my village
outcomes: The soldiers are not alerted by the baby's crying
